Overview
This is an opportunity to leverage your problem-solving talents and modern front-end development practices to create delightful user experiences for complex workflows.  ArcGIS Business Analyst is Esri's location-based market and community intelligence software that combines demographic, business, lifestyle, and census data with map-based analytics for smart decision-making. Our software helps customers identify the right growth sites and share analysis across their organizations. Join us as part of a dynamic team responsible for designing and developing the next generation of ArcGIS business solutions.
Responsibilities
Development, maintenance, testing and development of the Business Analyst Web App
Architect solutions working as a TypeScript programmer, writing scalable, reusable, and maintainable code
Evolve your language skills in TypeScript by staying current with complementary programming languages, development methodologies, user interface design techniques, and database tools
Work closely with other developers to develop robust components, integrating with other development teams
Diagnose and fix software problems
Requirements
2+ years of front-end development experience with Typescript
Proficiency with additional front-end development technologies (JavaScript, HTML, CSS, Node.JS, and more)
Experience with JavaScript frameworks (such as React, Angular, Ember)
Experience developing web components and UI & Unit testing
Experience with Figma, Storybook
Excellent problem-solving, design, development, and troubleshooting skills
Understanding and experience working with web services / REST APIs
Ability to work in a fast-paced and challenging environment
Excellent teamwork and communication skills
Experience with software development methodologies (SCRUM) and social coding (Git)
Bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering, or a related field
Recommended Qualifications
Master’s degree in computer science, engineering, or a related field
Familiarity with GIS/Esri software including ArcGIS API for JavaScript
Experience with linters
Experience with CI/CD, build processes, build tools, and managing dependencies
